$comment: Repo-root base tsconfig. Used as the TypeDoc/typecheck fallback config for libs/generic/* packages that don't ship their own tsconfig.json (see scripts/gen-lib-api-docs.ts + apps/operator-docs/astro.config.mjs's starlightTypeDoc entry). Minimal compiler options sufficient for a package to typecheck on its own; apps (e.g. apps/operator) compile via their own tsconfig and ignore this file. (Formerly also referenced by the now-deleted libs/zero-harness/tsconfig.json — zero-decommission-2026-06-20.)
